limitations: Same assistant authored edits and reviewed sources, with original labels visible. Not independent, human, or blind review. Original episodes were inspected for structure/final answers and selected source support; this is not a full raw-teacher accuracy evaluation.

plan.hypothesis: Source review plus CPU-executed repairs recovers useful concise demonstrations from existing teacher runs without new API generation.
plan.selection: Answerable pool passes existing structural gate; unanswerable pool includes rejected old episodes. Exclude v3/v4 pilot target papers and all held-out target/reserved papers. Sample without replacement by paper; question list fixed before semantic review.
plan.decision_rule: Review all 32. Data salvage gate: at least 24 accepted including at least 10 per class. Accept only source-reviewed 2-6 action episodes with exact replay; allow explicit provenance-tracked repairs, exclude ambiguous labels or missing source evidence. No GPU training regardless of this data gate.
plan.reviewer_type: assistant; editor knows labels, not independent or blind
plan.budget: 32 existing episodes; local CPU only; no teacher API calls
plan.policy: Original archived teacher; revised actions authored by Codex and fully re-executed; no Qwen checkpoint run.

summary.gate_note: 23/32 accepted (15 sufficient, 8 insufficient) misses the declared >=24 and >=10 per class gate. Keep accepted examples, exclude the nine unsuitable targets, do not replace them after the fact to claim success.
